item.title: BVI Vacation Without Sailing Experience: Best Yacht Charter Options for Beginners
item.description: Picture waking up to the sound of waves against the hull of a catamaran anchored in a secluded cove in the British Virgin Islands (BVI). Walk on deck and soak up the sunshine and the spectacular views this area is famous for. It’s the perfect holiday, and the best part is that no sailing experience is needed. With Dream Yacht Worldwide , you can enjoy a BVI yacht vacation without having to know a jib from a mainsail. We make sailing accessible to all, with three options especially suited for beginners: Easy Crew, Skippered, and Cabin Cruises. Can You Go on a BVI Vacation Without Sailing Experience? Many people assume that exploring the ocean requires a formal captain’s license or a deep understanding of marine navigation. While renting a boat entirely on your own, known as a bareboat charter , requires sailing experience, there are plenty of ways to enjoy the sea without any technical knowledge. With a crewed BVI sailing vacation , you don’t need to stress about managing a vessel. Our team oversees managing the necessary tasks, such as tracking the weather, anchoring in a busy bay, or interpreting complex nautical terms. You’ll have experienced staff managing onboard systems for you while you enjoy the experience. Our modern catamarans are also stable boats, which means a very low risk of motion sickness and a comfortable stay for those new to life on the water. Best BVI Charter Options If You Don’t Know How to Sail Every traveler has a different preference when it comes to privacy, budget, and daily schedules. Dream Yacht Worldwide provides three distinct entry points designed to match your personal style. Best For Privacy Level Meals Budget Skippered Charter Families and friend groups High (Full private yacht) Cook your own meals or dine ashore Mid to High Easy Crewed Charter Milestone trips and relaxation seekers High (Full private yacht) Half or full board cooked by a host Premium Cabin Cruise Couples, solo travelers, and budget travelers Private cabin, shared deck Set meal plan included in the price Affordable BVI Skippered Yacht Charters: Ultimate Freedom and Privacy A skippered charter means you rent an entire yacht for your group and hire a professional captain to sail it. You have total control over your daily schedule, allowing you to choose exactly when to sail and which bays to visit. The captain handles all the physical labor, anchoring, and navigation, while you and your guests enjoy the exclusive use of the boat. A BVI catamaran charter with skipper is ideal for families who want to cook their own meals or try local beachside restaurants every night. BVI Crewed Yacht Charters: The Effortless Private Getaway If you want the ultimate luxury of a private boat combined with the service of an all-inclusive resort, consider an Easy Crewed charter . Along with a professional captain, you get a dedicated onboard host/cook to manage the galley and handle tasks like grocery shopping (provisioning) or cooking meals during your stay. Cabin Cruises: The Budget-Friendly Entry Point to Sailing A Cabin Cruise is a smart choice for those who want to experience the yachting lifestyle without renting an entire boat. You can book an individual, private cabin with its own bathroom on a large, modern catamaran. The journey follows a pre-planned route, and meals are prepared and served by the crew. Think of it as staying at a boutique hotel that drops anchor at a different, beautiful spot every day. Why the BVI Is Ideal for First-Time Yacht Vacations The British Virgin Islands are widely considered the sailing capital of the Caribbean. The unique geography of the region creates a gentle, welcoming environment for anyone new to the water. Line-of-Sight Navigation and Calm Waters One of the biggest comfort factors in the BVI is that you can almost always see the next island on the horizon. item.title: Sail the Med in style: New Excess catamarans available for charter
item.description: As the summer season approaches, Mediterranean sailing beckons with its crystal-clear waters, stunning landscapes, and rich cultural heritage. What better way to experience the Med than on a brand-new Excess Catamaran, perfectly designed for a sailing vacation of a lifetime? We have sparkling new fresh-from-the-factory Excess Catamarans arriving, and we’re excited to offer them for charter in some of the most amazing destinations in the Mediterranean, including Montenegro, the French Riviera, and Croatia. Get to know Excess sailing catamarans These sleek and stylish Excess 14 and Excess 11 catamarans are just a few of the latest exciting additions to our Dream Yacht fleet, and they’re packed with features that make them perfect for sailors and those looking to explore the best of the Mediterranean from aboard a new, thoughtfully-designed Excess charter yacht. If you haven’t sailed aboard an Excess Catamaran before, you’re in for a treat. Excess yachts place a special design emphasis on a satisfying sailing experience, with exceptional responsiveness at the helm and heightened sailing “sensations”. Excess achieves an excellent level of onboard comfort as well – but not at the expense of performance. Meet the Excess 14 & Excess 11 The recently released Excess 14 is gaining momentum with sailing enthusiasts for its substantial 46-ft length offering uniquely nimble handling, reduced drag and improved stability. The Dream Yacht charter version features 4-cabins and 4-baths with plenty of space for a larger group of Mediterranean adventurers. The smaller Excess 11 is 37-ft of sailing fun. It’s perfect for small groups and families to explore the Mediterranean, with 4 comfortable cabins and 2 baths. For those newer to sailing it’s designed for ease of sailing, with excellent visibility and self-tacking jib. More experienced sailors will appreciate the lively helm and thrilling sailing sensations. Both models feature the latest technology and innovations from Excess, including a sleek and modern design, a large cockpit with a sliding glass door, and a spacious salon with plenty of natural light. They are also equipped with a range of amenities, including air conditioning, generator, and watermaker, ensuring a comfortable and convenient sailing experience. Whether you’re an experienced sailor or just starting out, the Excess 14 and Excess 11 catamarans are sure to impress. Their combination of performance, comfort, and style makes them the perfect choice for a Med charter vacation. The new Excess 13 In addition to the Excess 11 and 14, Excess has announced that their newest catamaran offering will be announced at the upcoming La Grand Motte boat show this spring. The exciting new Excess 13 is a sleek, dependable and lively sailboat – a perfect charter vacation platform. Watch for arrivals into the Dream Yacht Charter fleet soon! Charter a New Excess 14 – Trogir, Croatia Trogir, located on the Dalmatian coast of Croatia, is a historic town surrounded by a stunning archipelago, with countless islands, bays, and beaches to explore – the perfect starting point for your Croatia sailing charter . Trogir is a UNESCO World Heritage Site, with a rich history dating back to the ancient Greeks and Romans. The town’s narrow streets and picturesque piazzas are filled with historic landmarks, including the stunning Trogir Cathedral and the Kamerlengo Fortress. The surrounding islands, such as the famed Hvar and Brač, offer a range of sailing opportunities, from secluded beaches to vibrant ports and harbors. Our new Excess 14 catamaran is available for charters from our base in Trogir, Croatia beginning June 14, 2025 offering the perfect opportunity to experience the best of Croatia’s sailing scene. Plan now and grab your chance at summer sailing aboard this brand new Dream Yacht “Super Premiere” sailing catamaran.
